title: Flow Cytometry-Based Gamma-H2AX Assay for Radiation Biodosimetry
author: Ghazi Alsbeih

steps_raw.title: A. Lymphocytes separation and fixation:
steps_raw.instruction: Collect blood samples in heparinized Vacutainers (BD, USA).

steps_raw.title: A. Lymphocytes separation and fixation:
steps_raw.instruction: Irradiate 2 ml aliquot of whole blood with the required radiation dose.

steps_raw.title: A. Lymphocytes separation and fixation:
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate for 30 minutes (or other time) at 37ºC.

steps_raw.title: A. Lymphocytes separation and fixation:
steps_raw.instruction: Take the 2 ml whole blood and dilute (1:1) with 2ml PBS in a 15 ml tube.

steps_raw.title: A. Lymphocytes separation and fixation:
steps_raw.instruction: Carefully layer the mix on 2 ml of Histopaque (Ficoll).

steps_raw.title: A. Lymphocytes separation and fixation:
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,200 g (Eppendorf 5810 R) for 15 min at RT.

steps_raw.title: A. Lymphocytes separation and fixation:
steps_raw.instruction: Isolate middle cloudy lymphocytes layer and wash 2-3 times with cold PBS*.

steps_raw.title: B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate lymphocytesfor 1 hour at 37ºC with primary antibodies (anti-phospho-histone H2A.X, Ser139, clone JBW301; Millipore, CA, USA), in a 1:200 dilution in a buffercontaining 1% bovine serum albumin (BSA) and 0.12 % TX-100.

steps_raw.title: B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate withsecondary antibodies (FITC-goat antimouse Ig BD Pharmingen, San Jose, CA, USA),in a 1:200 dilution in a buffer containing 1% bovine serum albumin (BSA) and 12 % TX-100, for 1 hour at 37◦C.

steps_raw.title: B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Suspend lymphocytes in fresh 400-500 μl of PBS according to cells concentration.

steps_raw.title: B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Measure gamma-H2AXfluorescence in lymphocytes using flow cytometer (LSR II, Becton Dickinson, USA) and analyze the data using PC-basedBD FACSDiva software. The following settings are used:

steps_raw.title: A. Lymphocytes separation and fixation:
steps_raw.instruction: Fix lymphocytes(1-5x10 6 ) with 2% paraformaldehyde (PFA) for 10-20 minutes on ice. Atthis stage, fixed lymphocytes can either be processed further forimmunostaining or stored overnight at +4 ºC .

steps_raw.title: B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
steps_raw.instruction: FITC laser excitationof 488 nm and emission of 533 nm.

steps_raw.title: B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
steps_raw.instruction: A single populationof lymphocytes is gated and used for mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) calculations.

steps_raw.title: B. γH2AX immunostaining and flow cytometry measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Yields of γH2AX arecalculated as the ratio of mean fluorescence intensity of irradiated versuscontrol samples.
*Note: All PBS washing step include suspending cells in 500 μl PBS and centrifuging (Eppendorf 5810 R) at 100rpm for 10 minutes.
